query: SELECT name, type FROM sqlite_master ORDER BY type, name; PRAGMA table_info(tab01..tab06); SELECT COUNT(*) FROM each table;
result: Six tables tab01-tab06 with opaque column ids fld001-fld095. Row counts: tab01=56822, tab02=229186, tab03=427907, tab04=551, tab05=1210, tab06=87769.
validation_method: read-only SQLite metadata and row counts

query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fld049), COUNT(*) FROM tab01; SELECT fld001,fld049,fld063,fld072 FROM tab01 LIMIT 5;
result: 21738 distinct values of fld049 over 56822 rows; values are Magic card names (Forest, Swamp, Island; Serra Angel, Angel of Mercy). tab01 is the card-printing table with fld072 as the unique card uuid.

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tab02 WHERE fld072 IN (SELECT fld072 FROM tab01); repeated for tab03 and tab06; SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE name IN ('tab02','tab03','tab06');
result: tab02/tab03/tab06 reference tab01.fld072. Declared foreign keys: tab02.fld072 and tab03.fld072 reference tab01.fld072, tab06.fld072 references tab01.fld072 with cascade delete, tab05.fld063 references tab04.fld081. Resolved rows: tab02=229170, tab03=427835, tab06=87769.
validation_method: foreign-key declarations plus join resolution counts

query: SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT fld081) FROM tab04; SELECT fld081,fld049,fld079,fld089,fld090,fld091 FROM tab04 WHERE fld081 IN ('ARC','CSP','10E','LEA');
result: 551 sets with 551 unique codes. ARC=Archenemy, CSP=Coldsnap (block Ice Age), 10E=Tenth Edition, LEA=Limited Edition Alpha (release 1993-08-05).

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT fld063 FROM tab01 WHERE fld063 NOT IN (SELECT fld081 FROM tab04));
result: 0 - every card set code resolves to exactly one tab04 set.

query: SELECT fld075, COUNT(*) FROM tab02 GROUP BY fld075; SELECT fld075, COUNT(*) FROM tab05 GROUP BY fld075;
result: tab02 has 12 labels: Japanese 31226, French 29301, German 28891, Italian 28698, Spanish 28639, Portuguese (Brazil) 25641, Chinese Simplified 20106, Russian 15878, Chinese Traditional 11106, Korean 9692, Phyrexian 3, Sanskrit 1. tab05 has the same 10 main labels, 121 rows each. query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT fld072,fld075,COUNT(*) c FROM tab02 GROUP BY fld072,fld075 HAVING c>1); same for tab05 on (fld063,fld075); SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fld063) FROM tab05;
result: 0 duplicates: tab02 is one row per card printing and language; tab05 is one row per set and language. 121 of 551 sets have translations.

query: SELECT fld077, COUNT(*) FROM tab03 GROUP BY fld077;

query: SELECT fld059, COUNT(*) FROM tab01 GROUP BY fld059; SELECT fld005, COUNT(*) FROM tab01 GROUP BY fld005;

query: SELECT SUM(fld022), COUNT(DISTINCT fld049) FROM tab01 WHERE fld022=1; SELECT SUM(fld033), COUNT(DISTINCT fld049) FROM tab01 WHERE fld033=1;

query: SELECT fld055, COUNT(*) FROM tab01 WHERE fld055 IS NULL OR fld055 NOT GLOB '[0-9]*' GROUP BY fld055; SELECT fld049,fld055,fld069 FROM tab01 WHERE fld055 IS NOT NULL LIMIT 8;

query: SELECT fld011, COUNT(*) FROM tab01 GROUP BY fld011; SELECT MIN(fld013), MAX(fld013), COUNT(fld013) FROM tab01; SELECT fld049,fld013 FROM tab01 WHERE fld013=1;
result: fld011 has 19 distinct REAL values starting at 0.0 (7327 rows) and including 0.5; non-null for all printings. fld013 ranges 1..20900 with 4761 NULL; rank 1 belongs to Sol Ring printings.

query: SELECT fld053,fld065,COUNT(*) FROM tab01 WHERE fld053='Summon - Angel' GROUP BY fld065; SELECT DISTINCT fld053 FROM tab01 WHERE fld053 LIKE 'Summon%' LIMIT 8;
result: 'Summon - Angel' occurs on 20 printings: subtype exactly 'Angel' 17, 'Angel,Spirit' 2, 'Angel,Warrior' 1. Subtype values are comma-separated lists; original type wording uses legacy forms such as 'Summon - Hero' and 'Enchant Creature'.

query: SELECT DISTINCT fld002 FROM tab01 WHERE fld002 LIKE 'Stephen%'; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tab01 WHERE fld002='Stephen Daniele'; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tab01 WHERE fld063='10E' AND fld002='Adam Rex';

query: SELECT * FROM tab06 LIMIT 3; SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fld072) FROM tab06;
result: Rows are (date, English ruling prose, card uuid), e.g. 2007-07-15 'You draw the card when Bandage resolves, not when the damage is actually prevented.'. 87769 rulings cover 26141 printings; 30681 printings have none.

query: Cross-table profiling of fld049, fld068, fld070, fld075, fld063 across tab01-tab06.
result: fld049 = card name in tab01/tab02 but set name in tab04; fld068 = English card text (tab01), localized card text (tab02) and ruling text (tab06); fld070 = full type line (tab01) and set type (tab04); fld075 = language only in tab02/tab05; fld063 = set code in tab01/tab05.

query: SELECT SUM(fld088=fld049), SUM(fld088 IS NOT NULL), SUM(fld088 IS NULL) FROM tab04; SELECT fld081,fld049,fld088 FROM tab04 WHERE fld088<>fld049;
result: fld088 non-null for 201 sets; 197 equal fld049; 4 differ (M19 'Core Set 2019' vs 'Core 2019', M20, M21, DDE); 350 sets have no fld088 value.

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tab04 WHERE fld089 IS NOT NULL; SELECT DISTINCT t4.fld081,t4.fld049,t4.fld089 FROM tab01 c JOIN tab04 t4 ON t4.fld081=c.fld063 WHERE c.fld049='Angel of Mercy';

query: SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT c.fld072), COUNT(DISTINCT c.fld049) FROM tab01 c JOIN tab03 k ON k.fld072=c.fld072 WHERE k.fld077='Banned' AND c.fld005='white'; SELECT MAX(c) FROM (SELECT fld049,COUNT(*) c FROM tab01 GROUP BY fld049);
